description: Blue rock pigeon song recorded May 2012 at Sangli, India; pulsed coos, 100 Hz hum

extractions.what: Tracked as a pulsed call (input coo-pitch-analysis, section 3.3): 4 of 6 segments used, each about 0.84 s, pulsed at about 19 Hz. The carrier in the loud core is 388 Hz, energy-weighted 390 Hz; three of the four notes open with a short element near 470 Hz, so each note opens high and settles lower. No component at half the carrier, so a fundamental cannot be separated from it.
extractions.note: Bird or birds not identified, equipment and distance not stated, 100 Hz hum and signs of clipping in the file, 7.47 s in all. Weak evidence: four noisy notes.
